answer: A random beacon samples 10% of agents each epoch: the chosen one must prove work before dawn or lose 5 of a 25-credit bond. Unpredictable sampling forces every fake to stay compute-ready, 10 credits an epoch, and the audit stoops like a falcon on missed checks. 1,000 fakes cost 10,500 an epoch against an 8,000 share: a 2,500 loss, plus 25,000 locked. Honest agents pay 10, earn 15, and reclaim their bond after 20 epochs, pings light as a zephyr.
